description: Who lives around an address. US: census tract median household income, home value, rent, median age, owner-occupied share, households with children, commute under 30 minutes, degree share and median year built (ACS 2020-2024), with the county, state and US figures to compare, plus county, place, ZIP and school district. UK: council, ward, constituency, rural or urban class and national park; England deprivation deciles (overall, income, employment, education, health, crime, housing, living environment, children); England and Wales median sale prices by property type for the postcode sector over the last 12 months (HM Land Registry).

address.description: Street address with town and ZIP or postcode, e.g. "7090 State Highway 80, Cooperstown, NY 13326" or "Ambleside LA22 9BB". Not needed when lat and lon are given.

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of address).

title: Neighbourhood profile
